usage: Each block begins with '/poll ' followed by the question on the same line. Type /poll in Discord and paste each value into the matching field.
option_rules: Vote options are exactly Yes / No / Abstain.
A No vote carries no 'needs revision' qualifier.

fields.question: <Proposal name> by <Author> — send to Senate vote?
fields.text: Author, Discord post link, Google Doc link, then the bullet summary (up to 5 bullets). This text appears above the poll.

line_item_rule: If the proposal has separable line items needing their own votes, generate one poll block per line item (the question names the line item) instead of a single combined block. Call the line items out after the summary bullets.
